messages:
maria-partnerships: Hey team — uploaded the latest Galileo joint brief assets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GalileoAssets
maria-partnerships: TL;DR: need logo lockup spacing check, illustration palette sign-off, and partner quote approval from legal + Galileo by EOD.
maria-partnerships: Files: /lockups/galileo_redwood_lockup_v3.svg, /illustrations/cover_illumination_v2.png, /copy/onepager_draft_v4.docx

josh-design: grabbing files now. quick q — should the Galileo mark be full-color or single-color for the lockup? sam_galileo said earlier full-color but partner guidelines are strict.

sam_galileo: Hi! Correct — Galileo prefers full-color mark when possible, but we can use single-color white on dark backgrounds. Please do NOT use grayscale versions. Also prefer 8px clearspace around the mark.

josh-design: noted. I tested a few spacing options. Current SVG has 6px — will update to 8px. Also flagged the logotype kerning near the "R" which looked tight.

liz-marketing: Illustration palette looks great overall. Only ask: can we nudge the accent from #0f2a6b (our midnight blue) to #0e2d74 to better match Galileo's brand hex? Should be subtle.

josh-design: easy tweak, will push a v3 with #0e2d74 and export PNG/SVG.

kevin-legal: Quick legal read: partner quote in doc uses phrase "industry-leading" twice. Suggest we remove one instance and swap to 'market-leading' to avoid puffery. Also need the Galileo signatory's name + title for the quote metadata.

maria-partnerships: @sam_galileo can you confirm signatory and OK with "market-leading" substitution?

sam_galileo: OK on wording — we prefer 'accelerate' instead of 'transform' in the second sentence. Signatory: Samira Vela, VP, Alliances. She can sign off by 5pm PT.

maria-partnerships: Great. Kevin, make the doc change and send to Samira for e-sign.

kevin-legal: Will do. Also flag: the solution brief mentions an SLA number for Redwood Dedicated that isn't public. Remove explicit 99.9% from the public brief, replace with 'SLA-backed uptime' generic phrasing.

josh-design: FYI the lockup SVG snippet I updated:
```
<svg width="240" height="48" viewBox="0 0 240 48" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Galileo mark (full color) -->
  <g id="galileo-mark" transform="translate(8,8)"> ... </g>
  <!-- Redwood lockup -->
  <g id="redwood-logotype" transform="translate(120,12)"> ... </g>
</svg>
```
josh-design: I'll attach exportables in a minute.

brandbot: asset-checker: lockup spacing passes (8px), color contrast OK for light/dark variants, missing alt-text on /illustrations/cover_illumination_v2.png

liz-marketing: Good catch. Proposed alt text: "Illustration showing Redwood and Galileo architectures converging — stylized cloud nodes and latency curves." Thoughts?

sam_galileo: Approved alt text. Also can we avoid using the word 'partnered' in the first line; Galileo prefers 'in collaboration with' per co-marketing policy.

maria-partnerships: noted — will adjust copy.

josh-design: Uploading exports: https://drive.google.com/file/d/galileo_lockups_v3.zip

liz-marketing: Can design also export a 1200x627 social tile with the partner-approved headshot? We need that for the publish queue.

sam_galileo: Headshot file uploaded to Drive: /partners/galileo/headshot_samira_vela.jpg

maria-partnerships: Summary of action items: 1) Josh — push lockup + illustrations v3 with #0e2d74 and 8px clearspace, include 1200x627 social tile. 2) Kevin — update quote wording and remove SLA specifics, send to Samira for e-sign. 3) Liz — update copy to 'in collaboration with' and add alt text. 4) Sam — confirm sign-off by 17:00 PT. 5) Brandbot — re-run asset check after updates.

kevin-legal: on it.
maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If we get sign-off today, target publish to marketplace on Tue. :rocket:

sam_galileo: team copied — Samira will review + sign by 4:30pm PT.

josh-design: done — uploaded new zips and PNGs. ping when legal is good and i'll push final exports.

brandbot: asset-checker: re-scan complete — all required alt-text present, color delta within partner tolerance, no prohibited fonts detected.

liz-marketing: awesome. scheduling draft in the CMS; hold for final signed quote.

maria-partnerships: closing loop — if anything else pops up, drop here. thanks! :thumbsup:
